mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, thereby increasing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in aggregate demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1.0% over three months signals a supply-side disruption that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1.0% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (GDPC1) relative to historical norms indicates strong economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 is above the 75th percentile of its historical distribution, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained acceleration in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL rising more than 0.5% over three months) signals an impending monetary policy tightening, which increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a sharp contraction in the labor market, which depresses consumer confidence and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises from prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising more than 0.5% over three months) indicates an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
